title: DeepSeek Harness v0.2.1-alpha.1 Adds Experimental Claude Code Mods Compatibility Layer
key_facts: DeepSeek published Harness v0.2.1-alpha.1 on GitHub on 3 Oct 2026, less than a week after the v0.2 preview added desktop installers and a plugin manager to its open-source agent application.

Main addition: an experimental compatibility layer that runs Claude Code Mods (Anthropic's new JavaScript/TypeScript customization hooks for its coding agent, launched at the start of October) as Harness plugins.

DeepSeek's release notes say the goal at this stage is to verify that the Mods API is broadly a subset of what Harness plugins can do, not to offer full practical compatibility; the change is credited to Harness team lead Cui Tianyi.

Anthropic's example mods Token Weather, Blast Radius and Replay Theater run; four mods from Anthropic's repository (diff, agents-md, sec-default, telemetry) are marked not runnable; mods load through Harness configuration and run without a sandbox.

Also new: a 'Let Agent create a plugin' entry, an optional Developer Tools bundle with raw session logs and host diagnostics, bug fixes and breaking changes for plugin authors including removal of runtime invariant plugins.
quote_evidence: DeepSeek published DeepSeek Harness v0.2.1-alpha.1 on GitHub on October 3, in the middle of China's National Day holiday and less than a week after the v0.2 preview added desktop installers and a plugin manager to its open-source agent application.

At this stage, the layer is meant to verify that the Claude Code Mods API's capabilities are broadly a subset of what Harness plugins can do, rather than to offer users complete, practical compatibility.
Mods cannot simply be copied over: they load through Harness's own configuration and run without a sandbox.
why_it_matters_hint: A Chinese open-source agent runtime is moving within days to absorb Anthropic's new extension format, an early sign that coding-agent add-ons could become portable across rival tools.
notes: Pandaily page is JavaScript-rendered; text recovered from the page's embedded data. Facts rest on Pandaily's reading of DeepSeek's GitHub release notes; no other outlet found covering this alpha (MarkTechPost covers the earlier v0.2 desktop apps). Alpha software, experimental feature.
